name: Hercules

abilityDetails.Infuriate: Rakip daha saldırgan hale gelir ve saldırı yetenek doğruluğu azalır.
abilityDetails.True Sense: Bu saldırılar Otomatik Blok ve Miss etkilerini yok sayar.
abilityDetails.Power Gain: Güç barlarını anlık veya zamanla doldurur.

signatureAbility:
Son of Zeus
Once per fight when receiving damage that would result in a knockout, gain an Immortality Buff preventing death and making Hercules Unblockable for [3.2 - 9] seconds. Immortality is paused during personal Special Attacks or while landing Basic Attacks and is removed if the Opponent activates their Special Attack 3.
For 2 second(s) after completing a feat, gain [6 - 35]% Combat Power Rate.

abilitySections.title: Always Active
content: Blessings bestowed from the Goddess Hera protect against physical injury, reducing the potency of incoming Bleed effects by 50%.
A strong resilience to conventional drugs and toxins reduces the potency of incoming Poison effects by 15% and makes the recovery reduction from Poison 20% less effective.

abilitySections.title: Feats of Strength - Passive - Max Stacks 12
content: Feats: 1. Strike a non-stunned Opponent with any hit of a Heavy Attack. 2. Intercept a dashing Opponent with an attack. 3. Stand up after being knocked down.
Completing a feat grants 1 indefinite Strength, each increasing Armor Penetration by [195.65] and causing Attacks to deal a burst of Physical Damage equal to 10% of the damage they dealt.
The first time each unique feat is completed in a fight, gain +1 Persistent Strength for the rest of the quest, allowing Hercules to start each fight with Strength equal to his Persistent Strength.

For 2 second(s) after completing a feat, Hercules gains +[1,325.8] Attack Rating and +50% Buff duration. If a Special Attack is activated during this time, the bonus remains throughout the Special Attack.
While Hercules has Strength he becomes Stun Immune. Each Stun prevented by this immunity removes 1 Strength.

abilitySections.title: Dashing back after landing the first Light or Medium hit in a Combo
content: Inflict a non-stacking Infuriate Debuff for 7 seconds, making the Opponent more aggressive and reducing their Offensive Ability Accuracy by 60%. Cooldown 10 seconds.
While fighting as a Defender the duration of Infuriate is increased to 10 seconds and it is triggered whenever Hercules dashes back.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: On Activation gain a True Sense Buff, bypassing the effects of Miss and Auto Block for 16 seconds.
The first hit grants a Precision Buff increasing Critical Rating by +[2,250] for 25 seconds. If this attack was used to intercept a dashing Opponent gain +2 additional Precision Buffs.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: The Potency of Burst Damage dealt via Strength during this attack is increased by 50% for each Armor-Up effect on the Opponent, up to a maximum increase of 200%.
The first hit grants a Cruelty Buff increasing Critical Damage Rating by +[1,321.43] for 15 seconds. If this attack was used to intercept a dashing Opponent gain +2 additional Cruelty Buffs.
The final hit has a 100% chance to inflict a 3 second Stun Debuff.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: Gain an Indestructible Buff preventing all damage for 4 seconds.
After this attack, if the Opponent has 3 Bars of Power Hercules gains a Power Gain Buff, granting 100% of a Bar of Power over 3 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Signature Ability - Son of Zeus
content: Once per fight when receiving damage that would result in a knockout, gain an Immortality Buff preventing death and making Hercules Unblockable for [3.2 - 9] seconds. Immortality is paused during personal Special Attacks or while landing Basic Attacks and is removed if the Opponent activates their Special Attack 3.
For 2 second(s) after completing a feat, gain [6 - 35]% Combat Power Rate.
